metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to color all vowel-starting words red and consonant-starting words blue in a 52-word table. Failed after 50 turns due to repeated incorrect color selection in LibreOffice custom color picker.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent demonstrated ability to: double-click words to select them, open Format > Character > Font Effects dialog, open color picker dropdown. Failed at reliably picking the correct color from the palette.
metadata.failure_analysis: Estimated failure at step 25. Color picker navigation was unreliable - agent confused different color swatches. Simplifying to one word with blue color tests consonant-word coloring in isolation.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the blue (consonant) coloring side of the original task with minimal scope - a single consonant-starting word 'do'. The agent understood the red/blue scheme from reasoning but couldn't execute it reliably at scale.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator reads Dolch_Sight_Words_Primer.docx, extracts font color of word 'do' from the table, and checks it is within tolerance 50 of blue (#0000FF). Initial state has 'do' in #2A3139, so the task requires an actual change. [Fixed: renamed functions to use proper 32-char MD5 hash e97799f0add4268fcc31cdd1e95ac277; inlined nested _color_match helper to eliminate false-positive validator detection of non-conforming function name]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter get_word_font_colors__a82150361752 -> get_word_font_colors__e97799f0add4268fcc31cdd1e95ac277 (invalid 12-char suffix -> proper 32-char MD5)
Fix 2: Renamed metric check_word_colors__a82150361752 -> check_word_colors__e97799f0add4268fcc31cdd1e95ac277 (invalid 12-char suffix -> proper 32-char MD5)
Fix 3: Renamed nested helper color_match -> _color_match to prevent validator from treating it as a top-level metric requiring MD5 suffix
Fix 4: Updated result.type in evaluator from word_font_colors__a82150361752 to word_font_colors__e97799f0add4268fcc31cdd1e95ac277

Fix 5: Inlined _color_match logic directly into check_word_colors__e97799f0add4268fcc31cdd1e95ac277 to eliminate validator error: nested function '_color_match' flagged as metric requiring MD5 hash suffix

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly opens the .docx file, iterates all tables/rows/cells/paragraphs, and extracts font color per word into a lowercase-keyed dict.
Metric correctly looks up 'do' (case-insensitive) and compares the actual color hex to #0000FF (blue) within a per-channel tolerance of 50.
Negative control is sound: the initial font color #2A3139 has B=57 vs B=255 for blue, a difference of 198 which far exceeds tolerance 50, so the unedit state will not pass.
Evaluator scope is appropriately narrow: only checks the single word 'do', matching the simplified task instruction.

Minor issue: the `break` in the getter's run loop is placed unconditionally outside the `if run.font.color.rgb is not None` block, so only the first run of each paragraph is ever examined. For simple single-word table cells (as expected in this document) this is functionally correct.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Move the `break` inside the `if run.font.color.rgb is not None:` block (or remove it) so that if the first run has no color set, subsequent runs in the same paragraph are checked. This prevents silent miss on multi-run words.
